notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
This is a major update that fixes some existing issues, as well as adding some much needed polish in various places. Gameplay is also changed significantly with the introduction of a couple new characters.
[list]
[*] Added 3 new characters with unique strengths and weaknesses
[*] Overhauled gameplay audio
[*] More team customization - Select your roster and name your players
[*] More effects and juiciness
[*] AI tweaks
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mlD8rxD.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
- Game is now pausable in singleplayer.
- Added ability to rebind controls and manage controllers.
- Improved Controls page descriptions.
- Fixed popup options not highlighting correctly with controllers.
- Reworked In game menus.
- General responsiveness and visual improvements in UI.
